name: Pi Tools
description: Lean pi_-prefixed toolset container (read, bash, edit, write). Constructed as a single plugin so all four tools share one cwd and one manifest.

cwd.description: Default working directory for relative paths. Defaults to the agent workspace at registration time.

maxOutputLines.description: Output truncation limit for pi_bash and pi_read. Default 2000.

maxOutputBytes.description: Output truncation byte limit for pi_bash and pi_read. Default 51200 (50KB).

enableImageReads.description: When true, pi_read returns image content blocks for supported image MIME types. Default true.
